primary_endpoints: Whole KIX raw RMSF delta prediction MAE against zero response and Static baseline
L12 mean raw RMSF: MLL-cMyb and both-apo, all eight prespecified residues
secondary_endpoints: All six state contrasts for raw RMSF and Hchi
Within-state percentile absolute and delta scores
Nonadditive simulated-readout descriptor both-myb-mll+apo, not affinity
hchi_inclusion: All n_chi_angles>0; Pro included. Ala/Gly unavailable. 77 KIX and 6 L12 sites.
percentile: 100*(average rank-1)/(n-1), within each state/repeat/metric, and separately each fixed model; then MD repeat-equal mean
delta: State mean after minus before. All nine cross-repeat combinations retained as sensitivity; they are dependent combinations, not nine MD repeats.
static: Use current corrected fold1 fitted baseline, same train/test provenance as corrected Full; no fit on MD
model: Fixed corrected fold1 Full primary; any other checkpoint/ensemble only explicitly frozen secondary
uncertainty: Three independent starts per state; report all values, SD, min/max. No p, bootstrap CI or claim of convergence.
completion: 12 complete 10+100ns jobs, all production checksums/frame counts, per-repeat QA, complete absolute/delta tables, and interpretation including discordant signs
